text:
maria: Following yesterday's postmortem, a pattern: follow-ups evaporate after a week. Proposal: a tiny, mandatory follow-up template + brief IC checklist so ownership and timelines stick.
sam: +1. If owner missing it becomes 'infra' and never happens. Need person, not team.
kevin: Agreed. Also want SLA windows: P0: 1w, P1: 2w, P2: 4w. Keeps expectations clear.
anya: Minimal fields: Owner, Priority, Due, Verify, DoneCriteria, Recurrence, PM link.
maria: Draft template I can turn into a GH issue template:
```
Owner: <name>
Priority: P0/P1/P2
Due: YYYY-MM-DD
Verification: link to smoke/CI job
Done criteria: e.g. "no write errors 7d"
Recurring?: yes/no + notes
Comms cadence: who to ping at 24h/72h
Postmortem: <url>
```
jess: Add a 48h IC check (15m) to confirm owners + timelines. Also daily updates while open.
sam: Automation: create GH issue from PM, webhook posts /remind commands and pings owner n-1 day before due.
incident-bot: Tip: you can do `/remind @owner on YYYY-MM-DD to update follow-up` and link GH actions to comment when CI passes.
maria: For IC rota: propose 2-week rotations + a shadow during major releases. Less churn, better handoffs.
kevin: :thumbsup: shorter rotations help knowledge distribution.
anya: I'll add a one-line handoff row to the rota sheet: open incidents, actions, owners, contact.
jess: I'll write the CI smoke job and a small verification script that comments on the GH issue.
sam: If no objections, maria will create the GH issue template + tracker today and I will help wire reminders and the webhook.
maria: Will post links & a short HOWTO by EOD and assign preliminary owners for KV actions (kevin, jess, sam). Thanks! :pray:
